subject: Request to rebook demo — adding security & procurement stakeholders
messages:

Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Demo confirmation — Fri 20th 11:00 PT?

Hi Todd —

Thanks for the time yesterday. Per our chat I’ve penciled in a 45-minute walkthrough for Friday, Feb 20 at 11:00 AM PT to cover the Redwood serving runtime, routing policies, and the procurement/security checklist.

Attached is a short agenda and a couple prep questions so we can tailor the session. If anyone else on your side needs to join (security, infra, procurement), please do let me know — happy to expand the slot.

Agenda (attached): 1) Overview & architecture 2) Live demo — low-latency path 3) Q&A / next steps

Looking forward —

Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Redwood_Demo_Agenda_v2.pdf, Pre-demo_questions.docx

From: Todd Armstrong <todd.armstrong@finchance.com>

Cc: Priya Suresh <priya.suresh@finchance.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo confirmation — Fri 20th 11:00 PT?

Thanks Jasmine — that time would have worked for the core team, but we just looped in Priya (head of procurement) and she’s out for travel that day. Also our security lead Evelyn will need to attend; she’s back in office Mon 23rd. Could we look at early next week instead and make the session a full 60 minutes to include the procurement checklist and threat model review?

Apologies for the churn — everyone wants to be present for compliance and procurement sign-off.

Todd
VP Product, FinChance Capital

Thanks Todd — absolutely, glad to include procurement and security.

To make sure we cover everything, can you confirm which stakeholders from your side will attend and what their priority topics are? From our side I’m adding: Dev (solutions engineer) to run the live demo and address latency/kv cache questions; Soojin (solutions) to cover integration patterns; Evelyn (security) to address threat model and data flow; Rishi (AE lead) to cover rollout and contracting items.

Proposed 60-minute slots (PT):
- Mon Feb 23, 10:00–11:00
- Mon Feb 23, 14:00–15:00
- Tue Feb 24, 09:00–10:00

If none of these work, share 2–3 alternatives and we’ll coordinate. Also attaching a revised agenda that includes a procurement checklist and security prep.

Thanks —

Jasmine

If we go Mon 23 I recommend Soojin run the live demo with my lab notebook and I’ll hop on for the Q&A.

If that’s acceptable I’ll sync my demo checklist with Soojin tonight.

Team —

Given procurement and security need to be present, I’d prefer we book the slightly longer slot on Tue Feb 24 09:00–10:00 PT so Dev can lead and Evelyn can run through the threat model. That time also gives Priya a full business day after travel to join. Jasmine — can you lock Tue 24 09:00 PT if that works for FinChance? I’ll update the internal roadmap notes and capture the follow-up action list (contracting/PO timeline).

Rishi

Excellent — thanks all for the quick replies. Todd / Priya: Tue Feb 24, 09:00–10:00 PT is now booked on our side. Calendar invite to follow from my assistant.

What we’ll cover: 60-minute run (30 min demo + 20 min security/procurement checklist + 10 min next steps). Dev will lead the demo; Soojin will show integration patterns; Evelyn will walk the threat model and data residency options; Markus will be available for questions about private deployment and network requirements. Rishi will summarize contracting cadence and next steps.

Pre-work for FinChance: please attach any existing security questionnaire (if you have one) or answers to the attached pre-demo questions by EOD Mon Feb 23. That’ll help Evelyn prepare.

Attachments: Redwood_Demo_Agenda_v2.pdf, Pre-demo_questions.docx

Thanks — see you on Tue.

Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
